notes.title: Smash it Wild: A New Game by Goblinz Studio
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

After our trailer debut at the MIX Fall Showcase, we're excited to officially announce Smash It Wild, developed by Goblinz Studio in collaboration with Ernestine! This tactical turn-based game where volleyball and dodgeball meet in a fantasy universe is coming to you in Q2 2025!

[h3][b]Watch the reveal trailer[/b][/h3]
[previewyoutube=0bTu4-ZJiSM;full][/previewyoutube]

Dive into a fantasy world where champions face off in an unforgiving tournament. In Smash It Wild, every match counts, mixing volleyball and dodgeball in tactical turn-based gameplay. Upgrade your players, kit them out with powerful items, discover unique synergies and do your best to survive this roguelike competition where defeat means starting all over again.

[h3][b]Features[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*][b]Turn-based tactics[/b]: play matches mixing volleyball and dodgeball, where every action can make a difference!

[*][b]Sailpunk universe[/b]: take part in a tournament in a fantasy world filled with animals with a wide variety of abilities.

[*][b]Roguelike progression[/b]: win consecutive matches to find victory. One defeat means starting from scratch!

[*][b]Perfect your strategy[/b]: each team has its own synergies and combos, offering a variety of gameplay styles and strategies to adapt to each match.

[*][b]Create combos[/b]: train your champions, unlock new attacks and equip them with powerful items.

[*][b]Secondary challenges[/b]: complete bonus objectives during matches to gain additional rewards.
[/list]
[h3][b]Wishlist now[/b][/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2432240

notes.title: Hotfix 1.1.0.2
notes.content:
[list]
[*] New attack description system to help with tooltips font size and readability. Hold the right mouse click on a fighter tooltip or press the left stick button on your controller to switch between attack description and effect description.

[*] Fixed an issue during the preparation phase where some artefacts with group composition or position conditions could lead to a soft lock in specific situations.
[*] Fixed an issue with the Ghost’s passive attack not triggering correctly when interacting with the Crystal Skull and Bat Mask artefacts.
[*] Fixed an issue where the Skeleton Lord’s talent granting a Bonus when a hero would lose a fragment in the master’s room was not working if said fragment was lost because of a Morale over time effect.

[*] Fixed an issue with the Huntress champion’s passive not applying the intended amount of Enraged stacks to herself.
[*] Fixed an issue with the Dwarf champion’s attack not applying the intended amount of Vulnerable stacks to himself.
[*] Finally fixed the issues with the Flame Eater’s Spontaneous Combustion attack calculation for damage dealt and for damage preview, especially when equipped with the Two Birds Stone artefact.
[*] Fixed an issue with the Knight’s Ash aretfact incorrectly showing Morale preview on the second target when equipped with the Two Birds Stone artefact.
[/list]

notes.title: Soul Smugglers DLC - Available Now!
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

This is it: the last Legend of Keepers DLC is now available - including in the [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/22664/Legend_of_Keepers_Deluxe_Edition/]Deluxe Edition Bundle[/url][/b] and the [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/22665/Legend_of_Keepers_Collection/]Collection Bundle[/url][/b] with [b]huge discounts[/b]!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1966480/Legend_of_Keepers_Soul_Smugglers/

We are so happy to have been working on this game for 4 years.

Since the release of the prologue in 2019, so much has happened. We've attended incredible events, met amazing players, received tons of positive messages and constructive feedback that have allowed us to improve the game as best as we could.

Then we released free updates and paid DLCs to keep the franchise alive while focusing on our other internal and published projects.
And even though we are now working on several exciting projects, Legend of Keepers will always have a special place in our hearts.

So thank you to all Legend of Keepers players and to the best community for playing our game!
The adventure has just begun...

♥,
The Goblinz Team

notes.title: Hotfixes 1.0.1 to 1.0.5
notes.content:
We've just updated the game with a hotfix containing some slight balancing adjustements and fixes for the most recent (yet annoying) bugs reported by our players.

Thank you all for your feedback and support!

Have fun!

[list]
[*] Bard’s base Power has been reduced from 70 to 50 for Concertist and Virtuoso.
[*] Experience gained in Endless mode has been increased by around 30%.
[*] Removed the Early Access panel when launching the game for the first time. (oops!)
[*] Fixed an issue with Thorns causing several major issues with heroes attacks and dungeon progression.
[*] Fixed an issue where changing the Special Event Themes in the settings would make them overlap on the menu screen.
[*] Fixed an issue allowing players to click the Sponsor button during the Secret Ingredient event without having enough tears.
[*] Fixed an incorrect amount of Life displayed during the Slimy Yet Satisfying event.
[*] Fixed an issue where the first artefact at the Archivist was not selected by default.
[*] Fixed an issue where monsters were not correctly displayed at level 2 for the Ascension mode team interface and in the team editor.
[*] Fixed an issue where monsters and traps tooltips in the Endless mode team interface were not showing up when hovering them.
[*] Fixed an issue where the Master’s stats in the info window after a run was still affected by the previous run upgrades.
[*] Fixed an issue where the Enchantress’ arcane spells during the Ritual task were not showing the correct visual when upgraded twice.
[*] Fixed an issue where giving up during Preparation Phase was softlocking the game.
[/list]

EDIT: Hotfix 1.0.2

[list]
[*] Fixed an issue for saves created prior to the release update with a run in progress that would result in a softlock when losing or giving up during a dungeon.
[*] Fixed an issue with Slaveholder’s mission Return of the Vampire not having Skeleton monsters available during the run.
[/list]

EDIT2: Hotfix 1.0.3

[list]
[*] Fixed an issue with Bards attack when killing a monster benefitting from Thorns that could lead to unwanted game behaviors afterwards.
[*] Fixed an issue where modded monsters were shown in the team edition for Endless and Ascension modes.
[*] Fixed an issue causing the game to softlock if an Orc Sorcerer was killed by a hero’s skill while trying to revive a monster with his passive.
[*] Fixed an issue with modded heroes considered incorrectly as monsters in the modding tool.
[*] Add missing characters for Czech.
[*] Fixed an incorrect description for Gnoll’s passive in Russian.
[/list]
 
EDIT3: Hotfix 1.0.4

[list]
[*] Fixed an issue with Kamigoblins when their Kamikaze attack would soft lock the game if it kills all the units in the fight.
[*] Fixed an issue where the wrong Enchantress level to unlock the Engineer was displayed in the master selection window.
[*] Added another security during drag and drop in the team management window to prevent monsters or traps from ending in a floating spot in specific situations. Feel free to tell us if it still happens.
[*] Fixed an issue with modded heroes skills using the template animation sprites instead of the one from the modding folder.
[*] Empty attacks 2 and 3 folders for heroes have been removed from the mod files to avoid confusing modders.
[*] Fixed an issue where masters voice lines could be cut when launching a run during the transition to the Schedule scene.
[/list]

EDIT4: Hotfix 1.0.5

[list]
[*] Intro skip button has been moved to the bottom left of the screen to prevent any overlay from overlapping it visually.
[*] Intro can now be skipped with the escape key.
[*] Prevent events requiring monsters from being picked if no non rare monsters are available.
[*] Fixed an issue with Kamigoblins when dying after using the Kamikaze attack with the Berserker’s Manual Artefact equipped soft locking the game.
[*] Fixed an issue with specific monster attacks that could result in a soft lock when dying from the Archmage Ignited Shield damage reflect.
[*] Fixed an issue with the Bat Mask when having only 1 monster available in the Garrison that would be spawned several times when several monsters were killed simultaneously in the first monsters room.
[*] Fixed an issue with the hero’s passive preventing monsters from coming back to life that could result in a soft lock in specific situations.
[*] Fixed an issue in endless mode where the Motivation window after a dungeon was not displayed when beating the last champion group of a year. Additionally, it was preventing players from opening the Team Management window.
[*] Fixed an issue allowing monsters usually not available for a master to be picked for Event task choices regardless.
[/list]

notes.title: Legend of Keepers Full Release is out now!
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

[h3]This is it. After more than a year in Early Access, Legend of Keepers is now full released![/h3]

[previewyoutube=_e1RU9dcHOg;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]Release Update: 1.0 patch notes[/h1]

[h3]Features:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Ascension and Endless game modes are now available for everyone!
[*] 5 new monsters: Skeleton Cultist, Skeleton Executioner, Skeleton Bull, Possessed Armor and Time Watcher!
[*] 3 new traps: Monstrous Altar, Modified Fan and Trained Rats!
[*] New class of hero: the Bard! We’re sure you’ll enjoy crushing some dodgy, singing humans!
[*] 2 new champions: the Innkeeper and the Samurai!
[*] New intro when launching the game!
[*] 10 new Events!
[*] Supporter Pack owners can now activate the special event theme they want in the settings!
[*] Full controller support!
[/list] 
[h3]Improvements:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Performances in dungeons and transition to or from dungeons have been significantly improved.
[*] Elements unlocked during a run are now displayed at the end of a run after the experience animation.
[*] A button to automatically swap monsters from room 1 to room 2 has been added in the team management window.
[*] Enchantress’ arcane spells now have their level displayed during the Ritual task.
[*] A reminder message has been added in the team management window to remind players that monsters or traps can’t be moved around during a task.
[*] Effects from plunders are now displayed in the Plunder task UI and can be hovered for more details.
[*] Damage and Morale attacks preview is now taking the Dodge effect and hero’s passive into account.
[/list]
[h3]Balancing:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Magic Purse artefact costs reduction has been reduced from 50% to 30%.
[*] Ballista trap damage upgrades have been reduced from 40/50/70 to 30/40/55.
[*] Furnace trap base damage has been increased from 5 to 15. Damage from upgrades have been increased from 20/40 to 35/55.
[*] Dodge and hero’s passive allowing to avoid attacks are no longer triggered by monsters’ passives triggered and launched at the start of the turn like the Gargoyle’s one.
[/list]
[h3]Bugs fixing:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where tears cost of traps upgrades for level 4 and above was not removed from the player’s tears pool.
[*] Fixed an issue with the Ancestral Elemental’s third attack upgrade.
[*] Fixed an issue where only one of the available game over dialogs was displayed when losing or giving a run up.
[*] Fixed an issue where right clicking on a monster or in the team management window was not working anymore to move monsters around.
[*] Fixed an issue preventing the kills from Thorns effect to be counted correctly for the artefact unlocked at the Archivist.
[*] Fixed an issue where the Electrical Coil was not working as intended at level 4 and above.
[*] Fixed an issue with effects consumed from attacks that would generate unwanted turns skipping.
[*] Fixed an issue where Artefacts giving additional attacks were not triggered correctly for attacks with a conditional additional attack.
[*] Fixed an issue where heroes were going to the next room even if the last monster of the group was resurrected by the Crystal Skull artefact.
[*] Fixed an issue where the Elementalist attack could bounce even if the Pocket Mirror artefact was preventing the death of the targeted monster.
[*] Fixed an issue where the Unstable Elemental’s second attack was not giving shield if the target was killed from the damage.
[*] Fixed an issue where the Revealing Lense artefact was not triggering if the attack would lower the target’s life under the threshold.
[*] Fixed an issue where the Fang of Melinda artefact was triggered by attacks applying Burn even if the target was not already affected by Burn.
[*] Fixed an issue with the Advanced traps tooltips not showing the correct number of upgrades in their tooltip.
[*] Fixed an issue where modded monsters were randomly losing their attacks unlocked from level 2 to 4.
[*] Fixed several cases of possible interactions with the interface just before or when the motivation recap window after a dungeon was displayed.
[*] Fixed several issues where the fights could hang when killing or scaring one or several heroes at the same time that would lower the other heroes Morale to 0.
[*] Fixed several issues with the Orc Sorcerer’s resurrection passive when a monster would die from damage over time at the start of their turn.
[*] Fixed an issue where effects stacks were not correctly decreasing at the end of a hero’s turn if the hero killed the last monster of the group.
[*] Fixed heroes called “John Doe” in Endless mode past a specific amount of years.
[*] Fixed typos in different languages.
[/list]
Throughout this Early Access, we have been working hard to meet your expectations.
Thank you to our community for their invaluable feedback and unfailing support that has allowed us to constantly improve the game. ❤️

https://store.steampowered.com/app/978520/Legend_of_Keepers_Career_of_a_Dungeon_Manager/

To continue following the news of Legend of Keepers, [url=https://twitter.com/studio_goblinz]follow us on Twitter[/url] and [url=https://discord.com/invite/AbHKtmnX6G]join us on Discord[/url].
You can also [url=https://e3ccac1c.sibforms.com/serve/MUIEAOnrFlT75eLsKS_qAVcZrJgGsI7f9FXCJWX_6KqR8Dt6MjD6nU6tRwq0nwH19Mj1q2S4NKObbux3VefL723VftSlg_-B5VJ_8reJ8bBzUsNb7Ap8UW7Tq5voE2g68YKzPB9aQvK51nSw-ZHyhFK5iFPmevWbOExKh7auP-il1rF5BYCaXlrVmac0vuscpuRFZC_nUjyItMX7]subscribe to this dedicated newsletter[/url] to get exclusive content.
We're looking forward to seeing you there.

Have fun!

The Goblinz Team

notes.title: Hotfix 0.9.3.1 (including some improvements and balancing)
notes.content:
Here's a small patch for the latest game update.

We want to thank everyone on the forums and on our Discord for reporting us the issues they encountered to help us fix the game, as well as those giving us some feedback.

In addition, we wanted to clarify things around the new game modes we made available for Supporter Packs owners before launch. These modes are still in a "beta" state, but we couldn't wait any longer to share with the community what we've been working on for several months now. We wanted to show you that both the long awaited Endless and Ascension modes have been brought into the game. 

In addition, having access to new unfinished or unpolished content early is not initially included in the Supporter Pack. We are coming really close to the launch and the intentions behind this move was not to put the modes under some kind of DLC requirement but just to give a bonus for those already owning the Supporter Pack to thank them. This was a last minute decision and this was the best option we could find between this or nothing.

We also wanted to confirm that these new game modes will be included in the game at launch without requiring to buy any DLC.

We have heard the reactions of frustration or disappointment it created for some of our players and we truly understand. We can assure you we will find a better, clearer way to do it if we had to do something similar again in the future.

We're sorry for the confusion and we can't thank you enough for your feedback and your support!

Have fun!

[h3]Bugs fixing:[/h3]
[list]
[*] - Fixed an issue with one of the Artefacts unlock condition requiring to do fights with different monsters types.
[*] - Fixed an issue with years interface in the schedule scene that should only be displayed in Endless mode.
[*] - Fixed an issue with scaling for damage or morale over time Penalties in Endless mode as well as values in their descriptions.
[*] - Fixed an issue in Master’s spells and attacks upgrade tooltips in the dungeon rewards panel not showing the correct values.
[*] - Fixed several issues when killing and scaring heroes at the same time with an AoE could count the heroes defeated twice for game effects or tears gains.
[*] - Fixed an issue with monsters gained during the Plunder task not scaling with current year in Endless mode.
[*] - Fixed an issue with the warning on the Training course task in Endless mode.
[*] - Fixed an issue with the 3 Events related Steam achievements not registering correctly.
[*] - Fixed the spam issue on buttons used to launch a game on the master and mission selection.
[*] - Fixed an issue that was preventing heroes stats to be correctly refreshed after using the Enchantress’ Sand Storm arcane spell.
[*] - Fixed an issue with the level 4 of Ascension not correctly applying its effects to the number of stacks applied by disasters.
[*] - Fixed an issue allowing to open the settings panel during the motivation panel when coming back from a dungeon and preventing the player to close any of the two panels.
[*] - Fixed an issue with Futakuchi-onna’s level 4 upgrade on her first attack.
[/list]

[h3]Improvements and balancing[/h3]
[list]
[*] - Cursed Prism, Flying Dagger and Electrical Coil traps can now be dropped with any Master.
[*] - Oil Cauldron, Icy Breeze and Poisonous Plant traps base damage has been increased from 10 to 20.
[*] - Prismatic Stone and Revealing Lense artefacts have been reworked to make them more appealing.
[*] - Winged Boots artefact speed gained has been increased from 30 to 40.
[*] - Gargoyle’s got some love. Base power scaling on second attack has been increased from 0.5 to 0.75. Power gained at level 3 has been increased from 10 to 20. Demoralized stacks added to first attack have been moved from level 4 to level 3. Level 4 will now increase power scaling ratio on second attack from 0.75 to 1. Level 4 will now increase the stacks of Demoralized applied with the passive from 1 to 2. 
[*] - Gnoll had too much Life considering her full tanking potential and has been put back to 100 base Life instead of 120. In addition, Life gained with level 4 has been reduced from 40 to 20.
[*] - Traps can now be upgraded above level 4 in Endless mode. Traps gained during the run will also scale with the current year.
[*] - Heroes will now progressively gain more Power per level after the second year in Endless mode. The higher the year, the higher the increase.
[*] - Heroes will now gain levels quicker over the weeks in Endless mode.
[*] - Minibosses will now automatically gain Life and Power per year after the second year in Endless mode.
[*] - Advanced traps will now automatically gain a damage and morale increase per year after the second year in Endless mode.
[*] - Defensive Turret advanced trap base damage has been increased from 50 to 60.
[*] - Tesla Cannon advanced trap base damage has been increased from 30 to 40 and morale reduced from 30 to 20.
[*] - Grenadier advanced trap second passive when upgraded has been increased from Burn (1) to Burn (2).
[*] - Life gained by monsters per level up above level 4 has been reduced for “tanks” and “fighters” archetypes (from 40 to 30 and from 30 to 20 respectively). “Glass cannons” archetypes are remaining unchanged.
[*] - Champions encountered in the last dungeon of each year will be 1 level higher than before in Endless mode.
[*] - Experience gained in Endless mode has been significantly increased. 
[*] - Added a minimum of 25 to the amount of gold when skipping rewards in Endless mode.
[*] - Endless mode Steam achievements have been adjusted from 260 and 520 weeks to 156 and 260 weeks.
[/list]

notes.title: The last update before Full Release is out!
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

We are super excited to announce the release of our LAST UPDATE before the full release of Legend Of Keepers!

It's been almost a year since the game has been in Early Access. Your awesome feedback and support have allowed us to move forward in the best possible way. Thank you.

We are now close to the release and we hope you'll like this Final Update!

Here's the complete patch notes:

[h1]Update: 0.9.3 patch notes[/h1]

[h3]Features:[/h3]
[list]
[*] New Archivist section: keep track of the Artefacts available in the game and how to unlock more of them!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33904811/c2c99b8399621fc0d3343ab9f451efaefd2af257.gif[/img]

[*] New monster: the Futakuchi-onna!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33904811/a7605eb03091ecaa3fd8b5014f43121a5e240d59.gif[/img]

[*] New Artefacts to discover and play with!
[*] 12 new Steam Achievements!
[*][b] In beta for [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1247010/Legend_of_Keepers__Supporter_Pack/]Supporters[/url] only:[/b] new game modes - Ascension and Endless! Play with a default team or create your own with the team editor!
[/list] 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33904811/a55cc079eaf9e2cb4ad1ffc9c54375311a352fc7.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33904811/313d628f9fe17a447a66330adc1d960c975485e6.gif[/img]

[h3]Improvements:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Dialogs have been added throughout the game when starting or completing some missions, as well as random dialogs for game overs.
[*] Improved game over and victory animations.
[*] Game speed is now getting back to normal during Cyclops dialog.

[*] Save slots interface has been revamped.

[list]
[*] Masters max level has been increased from 20 to 30.
[*] Mechas’ base stats have been increased and stats gained when upgrading them have been slightly decreased accordingly.
[*] Orc’s Scream of Terror attack has been slightly tuned down.
[*] Gnoll’s base Life has been increased from 100 to 120. Base Speed has been decreased from 70 to 50 accordingly.
[*] Satyr’s attacks upgrades are now increasing stacks spread by 1.
[*] Skeleton Majorette’s first attack is now targeting the back instead of the front.
[*] Heroes’ Power and Morale per level have been slightly increased.
[*] Heroes’ passives regenerating Life or giving Morale back have been toned down.
[*] Healer’s skill has been reduced to 25% Life given back.
[*] Nomad’s skill has been reduced to 25% Morale given back.
[*] Campfire Morale given back and Fountain of Youth Life regeneration have been reduced from 20% to 15%.
[*] Base Life and Life per level have been tuned down for Hoplite and Archmage champions.
[*] Minibosses are now generated in the middle of dungeons instead of at the end.
[*] A few Artefacts have been tuned up to compete with the new Artefacts added.
[*] Traps costs at the Merchant have been reduced.
[/list]

[h3]Bugs fixing:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue with the Ghost’s attacks that were applying Demoralised stacks incorrectly.
[*] Fixed an issue with one of the Skeleton Scientist’s upgrades.
[*] Fixed an issue with one of the Boarman’s upgrades.
[*] Fixed an issue with one of the Gargoyle’s upgrades.
[*] Fixed tier 2 Nomad and Paladin Power per level which had way more than intended.
[*] Fixed an issue with one of the Slaveholder’s talents reducing the training price of monsters not increased correctly with the second talent point.
[*] Fixed several remaining issues with the Two Birds Stone Artefact spreading Morale, effects or dealing incorrect damage values.
[*] Fixed an issue with the Tar Ball Artefact not applied correctly.
[*] Fixed several issues with Artefacts trigger animations not displayed when needed.
[*] Fixed an issue with the Father of the Damned interview giving Armor.
[*] Fixed a few issues with Flame Shield effect interactions with attacks.
[*] Fixed several interaction issues with the Orc Shaman passive.
[/list]

Once again, thank you for your support since the beginning of the project. 
And if you have any feedback on this latest version, please let us know on [b][url=https://discord.com/invite/AbHKtmnX6G][Discord][/url][/b].

Cheers,

The Goblinz Team

notes.title: New update, new Discord, exclusive monster!
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

The latest update is now live! It includes a [b]huge rework[/b] on runs length and dynamic, a [b]new master selection[/b], [b]20 new artefacts[/b], [b]2 new status effects[/b] and[b] tons of improvements, balancing and bugs fixing[/b] (see the detailed patch notes below).

We also have a [b]new Discord server[/b], and an [b]exclusive monster[/b] is now available for our newsletter subscribers!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33904811/2f0b43866f913c58ce6f2a8ae7c75ea1cce4cab8.png[/img]

[h1]Update: 0.9.1 patch notes[/h1]

[h3]Features:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Huge rework on runs length and dynamic, starting monsters and rewards for missions, as well as an overall balancing! This is in anticipation of the Ascension system we are working on and the Archives section where players will be able to unlock new hidden artefacts that will be available soon.
[*] New master selection with a beautiful map for each master!
[*] 20 new Artefacts to discover!
[*] New monster for players who subscribe to the newsletter: the Grief Weaver! You just need to redeem the code sent by mail on the main menu to add it to the available monsters pool.
[*] 2 new Status effects: Guaranteed Critical and Dodge!
[/list] 

[h3]Improvements:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Default missions (previously called archetypes) are now a bit shorter than a year with specific weeks and enemies difficulty patterns. Each mission comes with its own repartition of heroes Tiers and levels. The reason for this was to make the game more dynamic, making the progression during a run less linear and slow. Reducing the length of the easiest parts of a run that were not really fun to play will allow players to dive into serious stuff more quickly. Players still eager to play during 2 years like prior to the update can use the customization settings to do so.
[*] Missions are no longer unlocked depending on the master level, but require to finish the previous mission instead.
[*] Enchantress is now unlocked when Slaveholder reaches level 5 and Engineer is now unlocked when Enchantress reaches level 3.
[*] Missions rewards have been adjusted for all masters, moving all of them one mission below compared to the previous version. 5th mission now has a new reward for all masters.
[*] Monsters and traps displayed in missions now have full information tooltips when mousing over them.
[*] Artefacts are now giving more interesting bonuses to make them better game changing elements.
[*] Some new artefacts are now displaying a Status on heroes to better keep track of stats bonuses monsters are benefiting from.
[*] Plunders result window has now a different thumbnail for each available plunder in the game.
[*] Some voices have been added to many monsters and heroes when attacking.
[*] Increasing game speed settings during dungeons no longer creates “chipmunks” voices.
[*] Gold gained in dungeons tooltips is now displayed with a min-max range.
[*] Enchantress’ promotion spells are now displayed and called “arcane spells” for better comprehension.
[*] Mousing over a dungeon in the Schedule scene will now display all the dungeons tooltips available for the week.
[*] In addition to Bonuses and Penalties, some effects are now considered as Statuses. They are displayed with gold text. Stunned, Guaranteed Critical, Dodge and Active Artefacts are considered as Statuses.
[*] Statuses are only removed when their effect is triggered. Statuses don’t lose any stacks when heroes are exploring a dungeon like other effects.
[*] When monsters are defeated, they will now either lose 1 or 2 Motivation. The final amount lost can be altered by game effects like talents or passives.
[*] Heroes groups generation has been improved.
[*] Players can now skip trap rooms if they don’t want to place a trap.
[/list]

[h3]Balancing:[/h3]
[list]
[*] All monsters and heroes have received balancing adjustments. Most of the changes have been made to increase fights duration, to reduce the chances for tanks and medium life pool monsters to be one shot by heroes, as well as better differentiate monsters archetypes. It has of course been done accordingly to the new artefacts power and new runs parameters.
[*] Several masters’ attacks and spells have been balanced.
[*] Interns have been balanced (minibosses).
[*] Disasters have been balanced.
[*] A few events have been balanced or adjusted.
[*] Values of heroes skills and passives that were regenerating Life or giving Morale back have been reduced.
[*] Hero’s passive with chances to stun can no longer be generated on Tier 2 and Tier 3 heroes.
[*] Monsters max level has been reduced from 5 to 4. All the stats and attacks upgrades repartition has been adjusted accordingly.
[*] Leveling monsters to level 4 now requires some Blood to justify the real power spike it represents (15 for rare monsters, 10 for the others).
[*] Most of the existing Artefacts have been reworked or balanced.
[*] Artefacts are now all considered as normal rarity. The rare reward for defending a dungeon from a group of adventurers containing a champion can now contain a normal artefact accordingly.
[*] Orc, Yetigo, Gnoll, Ghost, Infernal Guardian, Jubokko, Skeleton Magus, Skeleton Archer, Skeleton Lord, Skeleton Dog and Skeleton Warrior have received either a new attack mechanic or had their passive reworked.
[*] Morale percent given back to heroes by the Campfire resting room has been reduced from 30% to 20%.
[*] Enchantress’ Blight attack no longer removes Penalties on all heroes.
[*] Tiredness Penalty max damage dealt reduction has been reduced from 70% to 50%.$
[*] Engineer advanced traps have been rebalanced.
[*] Gold gained depending on dungeon difficulty has been rebalanced.
[*] Pile of Bones trap is no longer restricted to Slaveholder only and can now drop for every master.
[*] Electrical Coil trap has been reworked.
[*] Weeks duration and costs of Seminar and Sanctuaries effects have been reduced by half.
[*] Costs of monsters at the Merchant have been reduced by 50%.
[*] Merchant Refresh cost has been reduced from 50 to 20 gold and cost per refresh from 25 to 10 gold.
[/list]

[h3]Bugs fixing:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue causing a softlock when the Crystal Skull artefact would trigger on an intern death (miniboss).
[*] Fixed an issue that could lead to melee heroes not going back to their initial position correctly in specific situations.
[*] Fixed an issue with Enchantress’ Blight attack not taking Penalties applied to the targets into account correctly for damage calculation.
[*] Fixed an issue with the experience gained animation not showing a level up correctly when the amount of experience was equal to the remaining required amount to level up.
[*] Fixed an issue with Vampire Skin Artefact that was not applying its effects to monsters.
[*] Fixed an issue where damage could be negative in specific situations, causing the target to heal instead.
[*] Fixed an issue where the Frostbite application from the Monk class attack was not triggering when the condition was met.
[*] Fixed some remaining issues with the Wizard class skill when swapping monsters.
[*] Fixed an issue when swapping heroes with Enchantress’ Sand Storm arcane spell if there was a skeleton warrior from the Necromancer passive in the heroes group.
[*] Fixed some issues when Mysterious Screwdriver and Enchanted Cogs are triggered at the same time.
[*] Fixed an issue where gold gained displayed at the end of a dungeon was not correct.
[*] Fixed several typos.
[*] Fixed an issue where Slaveholder’s Interview task was allowing the same event to be picked more than once.
[*] Fixed several timing issues for effects gained when attacking, being attacked or defeating heroes or monsters. It was preventing effects from not being applied correctly.
[*] Monsters revived by the Orc Sorcerer’s passive are now correctly keeping their level instead of getting the Orc Sorcerer’s level.
[*] Fixed an issue where monsters could sometimes not be displayed correctly in dungeon rewards cards.
[*] Fixed an issue where the Gym task warning was not correctly displayed when needed depending on the resources available.
[*] Fixed an issue where the Fire Impaler’s second passive max value was not working correctly.
[*] Fixed an issue with the Ice Impaler’s first passive not giving the correct amount of Power per stack of Thorns.
[*] Fixed an issue preventing the Father of the Damned’s passive to work correctly.
[*] Fixed an issue preventing the Druidess champion from using her passive when affected by SIlence.
[/list]

[h3]Hotfix 0.9.1.1:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue preventing heroes from leveling up over the course of a run.
[/list]

[h2]Legend of Keepers has now a dedicated Discord server![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33904811/72243ce78170846239e0e880bbda286219331daa.jpg[/img]

Some of you are already part of the Goblinz Studio Discord server in which you can find all the latest news about all our games, but we wanted to go further and offer more things to Legend of Keepers players. In this new server:
[b][list]
[*] Get the latest news about Legend of Keepers
[*] Take part in giveways
[*] Share your best mods
[*] Ask questions to the team
[*] And more!
[/list][/b]
Join us now: [url=https://discord.gg/ZQ7Jds25Vc]https://discord.gg/ZQ7Jds25Vc[/url]

We hope to see many of you there!


[h2]Subscribe to our newsletter and get an exclusive monster![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33904811/e3f44a4d0e3c34903e4edb77650033074a25a9db.gif[/img]

The Grief Weaver has arrived! Harass heroes with a swarm of spiders or spit a poisonous web to defeat them! 🕸️

To get this new monster and exclusive news and content about Legend of Keepers, [url=https://e3ccac1c.sibforms.com/serve/MUIEAGFR59kO5HLJcqSjb2G4-Lg_IYY42EzXZRKiLvNw3I4GA0RW_7QB2vk3yGGzwBwHssgU5xiKEHgGBEvS0q6Qg8eZ8isNr9tgcpn7EftwlUbBVNU0jiv0HjGETGtH8lwQenxJDlVuw9YGkoroazbtfSEpk8tVA6IhgK_0fXeQLQFAcLvAJE6_FNSlsyiGvhgVhBMsz5-2jXgv][b][subscribe to our newsletter][/b][/url].

Cheers,

-Goblinz Team

[list]
[*] New Master: Lira, the Monkey Engineer! Coming with new exclusive Mecha monsters, 4 new exclusive traps, a new advanced trap room when getting a promotion and a new dungeon environment, the Cursed Temple!
[*] New Game mode archetypes system! Play the game with different starting monsters and traps and unlock more archetypes for more types of gameplay and challenges! Unlock monsters, traps or artefacts by finishing a run with a game mode archetype!
[*] New rare monsters to unlock: Skeleton Drake for the Enchantress and Kamigoblin for Slaveholder!
[*] New monsters: Ice, Fire and Earth Impalers for Enchantress, Skeleton Scientist available for every master and more to discover while playing! 
[*] News traps: 3 new traps to discover and unlock with the Enchantress and Polar Portal available for every master!
[*] New Artefacts to unlock with the archetype system!
[*] Dungeon defense contracts! Rewards type, gold gained and difficulty are now displayed before defending a dungeon and are more diverse.
[/list]

[h3]Improvements:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Attacks’ projectiles speed is now altered by the distance between fighters for a better visual feeling.
[*] Morale system has been further improved! Morale is now including a damage increase for every threshold. Thresholds are no longer preventing heroes from getting their Morale back once reached. In addition, heroes are now getting 5% Morale back when landing the final blow on a monster.
[*] Steam Artefacts related achievement has been updated and can be obtained again.
[*] Warning notifications on tasks in the Schedule scene have been improved.
[/list]

[list]
[*] Slaveholder’s talent giving him some Enraged stacks when taking damage has been changed to 50/100% chance to gain Enraged (1) when taking damage.

[*] Thorns effect is no longer available in the random Bonus pool for attacks, talents and artefacts.
[*] Morale lost by other heroes when a hero is defeated has been reduced from 20% to 15%.
[*] Elementals’ highest resistance matching their type has been reduced from 100% to 80%.
[*] Masters’ upgrades after a dungeon can now be stats, attack or spell boosts regardless of the master you’re playing with.
[*] Scepter of Destiny artefact no longer triggers on masters like it should have been initially.
[*] Vampire is now a rare monster.
[*] XP gained with masters has been reduced accordingly to the addition of the game mode archetypes system.
[/list]

[h3]Bugs fixing:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where a previous group of heroes containing a champion would continue to attack the upcoming dungeons in specific situations.
[*] Fixed gold gained displayed for the Magic Purse artefact when playing in custom mode with different gold gained difficulty settings.
[*] Fixed an issue with stats upgrades in events not added correctly to masters base stats.
[*] Fixed an issue with stats upgrades at the gym not refreshing correctly the masters base stats in tooltip before leaving the task.
[*] Fixed an issue with stats upgrades on modded monsters.
[*] Fixed an issue in Interview task where master’s life cost was not displayed correctly.
[/list]

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33904811/e59bec5eea41f3c75cda1d9d960c840ca08df70d.jpg[/img]

Hi everyone! We hope you're well. We just published our latest update!

[h3]Highlights of the new build:[/h3]

• Morale system improved
• Artefacts system reworked
• 3 new artefacts added
• Main menu interface updated

We thought you might be interested!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33904811/c62f13aae8e9160d2d77c5c9c708b17ebd5988ba.png[/img]

[h1]Update: 0.8.2 patch notes[/h1]

[h3]Features:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Morale system improved! Morale is now including 3 thresholds at 75%, 50% and 25%, preventing heroes from getting their Morale above a threshold once reached. In addition, heroes are now taking 50% more damage when their Morale is under 50%.
[*] Artefacts system revamped! They no longer have levels and rare Artefacts can now be obtained after a Champion dungeon.
[*] 3 new artefacts!
[*] Main menu interface has been revamped!
[/list]

[h3]Improvements:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Many existing events have been reworked and improved to include more choices, more decisive trade offs and be less punitive overall. In addition, some events will now even require the player to own a specific monster or artefact to get access to a more interesting alternative choice.
[*] Some visual FXs have been added for several monsters’ passives and for specific Masters’ talents.
[*] The “Info” tab in the master’s details window is now available with the master’s biography and stats.
[*] The random content generated for weekly tasks is now preloaded before clicking on them, allowing for a more accurate warning indicator when the player has a lack of resources or monsters required for the task. It is also no longer possible to generate events or other tasks with random content again by going back to the main menu.
[/list]

[h3]Balancing:[/h3]
[list]
[*] The effects of all existing Artefacts have been changed or adjusted according to the removal of Artefact levels.
[*] Business Trip missions containing an Artefact as a reward has been balanced accordingly.
[*] Mysterious Screwdriver Artefact can no longer drop until further notice.
[*] Base Speed of Gargoyle, Flame Eater, Naga and Satyre has been increased by 10.
[*] Fire, Ice, Wind and Earth Elementals now have the Resistance matching their element increased to 100%. They suffered a slight decrease in one of their other Resistances or Armor and a small adjustment to their level upgrades accordingly.
[/list]

[h3]Bugs fixing:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue with modded monsters being duplicated in specific situations.
[*] Fixed an issue with saves that could become corrupted in specific situations.
[*] Fixed an issue with Gym Armor bonus for the Master that was not correctly added to the Master’s stats.
[*] Fixed an issue where the master’s stats were not correctly refreshed after a task.
[*] Fixed a remaining issue with the Archmage Ignited Shield that could result in the master not being at the right spot during the final room fight.
[*] Fixed an issue where modded monsters level was not saved correctly when going back to the main menu during a run.[/list]

[h1]Update: 0.8.1 patch notes[/h1]

[h3]Features:[/h3][list]
[*] Heroes can now be created with our ingame Modding tool! (Steam only)
[*] Added a new modding interface to search for mods, subscribe, unsubscribe and vote for mods directly ingame!
[*] 8 new events have been added to the pool!
[*] 2 new events for each miniboss have been added to the pool during the second year of Slaveholder runs!
[*] New Masters artworks in the interface!
[*] Masters now have voice lines during dungeons![/list]

[h3]Improvements:[/h3][list]
[*] Mods are now enabled before starting a run independently for each save slot instead of activating them in the modding tool. Subscribing and unsubscribing to a mod will still activate or deactivate said mod for all save slots.
[*] Added a tooltip in the Schedule scene when hovering the Master’s portrait.
[*] Monsters and traps now have a different portrait border style depending on their level.
[*] Monsters and traps are now animated in the Shop.[/list]

[h3]Balancing:[/h3][list]
[*] Remaining heroes will now lose 20% of their maximum Morale when another hero is defeated (killed or scared).
[*] Base Morale and Morale per level have been increased accordingly.
[*] Hoplite’s base Life has been reduced from 450 to 400.
[*] Hoplite’s base Power has been reduced from 50 to 40.
[*] Hoplite’s Armor has been reduced from 80 to 70.
[*] Hoplite’s passives increasing damage dealt and damage reduction have been reduced from 50% to 35%.
[*] Druidess’s Nature Resistance has been reduced from 70 to 60.
[*] Druidess’s Air Resistance has been reduced from -15 to -25.
[*] Archmage’s base Life has been increased from 415 to 450.
[*] Archmage’s Nature Resistance has been increased from -35 to -25.
[*] Archmage’s Air Resistance has been increased from 25 to 35.
[*] Dwarf’s Life per level has been increased from 60 to 70.
[*] Dwarf’s base Power has been increased from 50 to 60.
[*] Power scaling ratio of the Enchantress’s Blight attack has been increased from 0.15 to 0.3.
[*] Lab Assistant events have been removed from the pool until further notice.
[*] Negative R&D events have been removed from the pool until further notice.
[*] The link between Thigh Supplier and Food Poisoning events is now clearer. Food Poisoning has also been made less punitive by reducing the healing cost to 200 instead of a cost scaling to the active monsters.
[*] Rare monster cost from New Talent event has been reduced from 500 to 300 gold.
[*] The monster killed through the Rematch event will now be chosen between the lowest level monsters available.[/list]

[h3]Bugs fixing:[/h3][list]
[*] Fixed an issue in the modding tool where unlock level for attacks was not saved correctly.
[*] Fixed several issues when deactivating mods while a run was in progress with modded monsters activated.
[*] Fixed an issue with passive attacks on modded monsters resulting in weird behaviors.
[*] Fixed an issue with mods folders not being deleted when unsubscribing from one, resulting in unsubscribed modded monsters to keep appearing during a run.
[*] Fixed an issue with modded monsters causing unwanted duplications.
[*] Fixed an issue with the Enchantress’s Blight attack not correctly getting bonus damage from Penalties removed from heroes.
[*] Fixed a remaining issue with the Siege task resulting in traps being duplicated.
[*] Fixed an issue when not having enough monsters for the Business Trip task.
[*] Fixed an issue with the Ballista that could soft lock the game.
[*] Fixed an issue where Artefacts displayed were not correctly refreshed after tasks.

[*] Fixed an issue where monsters and traps tooltips were not showing correctly on the room minimap.
[*] Fixed an issue where the Ring of Wrath artefact was applying to the Goblin’s Drummer team buff attack.

notes.title: 0.7.0.2 - EA Small Update - Pump It Up
notes.content:
It is a very delicate work: balancing. We've got to take into account new comers, mid-core players and veterans. We cannot only rely on individual input, we have to gather every feedback and see what are the big trend. When YOU feel X or Y is OP, we might have data that says otherwise.

You might no know, we have ingame analytics that help us understanding difficulty: what are the deadliest compositions, the most used skills and so on.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33904811/2ebb70a571eaefdd1a67377f4a8cdff543727cdc.png[/img]

We saw several streamers getting bored. We saw several people pausing after their first game, not even looking at the skill tree! We feel the roguelite-genre needs a few death to understand, reflect on your strategies and finally enjoy the game.

Today's patch is about balancing: we have globally made the game more dangerous, but you also have more health!

Remember to read the roadmap before asking what's upcoming:
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/ogg/978520/partnerevents/view/1841349580873384798]https://steamcommunity.com/ogg/978520/partnerevents/view/1841349580873384798[/url]

A dozen bugs have been patched as well.

---- Important note

We still need you opinion after playing. Do you feel these changes improve the game? Make it worse? We may have the general overview, your opinion still matters. Join the discord and tell us what you think!

[h1]Update 0.5.2.3 patch notes:[/h1]

[u][b]Features:[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Blood and Tears can be earned by killing heroes or making them flee!
[*] New tasks: Seminar, Sanctuary and Gym to spend your Blood and Tears!
[*] Master talent tree is now available! Play the game to level your master up and spend your points in the tree!
[*] New class of hero: The Nomad! Prepare yourself to see him give Morale back to allies!
[*] New trap: The Furnace! Here comes the season of BBQs!
[*] New dungeon environment: The Frozen Caves!
[*] New dungeon difficulty: You can now sometimes choose between Normal and Hard dungeons for better rewards (at your own risk)! 
[*] Russian, Spanish, Polish and Chinese languages are now available! (some texts can still be in English though since we have been added many things during the translation process)
[*] Steam leaderboard to compare your score with other players!
[*] Players can now share their score on Twitter and Facebook!
[*] 5 new Steam achievements!
[/list]

[u][b]Improvements and balancing:[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Base monsters pool is now composed of 7 fixed monsters plus 1 random one.
[*] Base monsters and traps pool has been slightly changed.
[*] Rare monsters cannot be found anymore in the shop, events and non Elite dungeons rewards.
[*] Rare monsters and Champions have now a golden tooltip border.
[*] You can now skip the tutorial in the settings panel.
[*] You can now also give up in the Schedule scene.
[*] Added a magic shield visual FX when the hero’s passive that ignores the first attack taken triggers.
[*] Added a visual FX when the Druidess Champion’s passive that removes Penalties stacks triggers.
[*] Sounds added to the Druidess and Hoplite Champions.
[*] Masters are now immune to Stuns.
[*] Added a fight notification when a fighter is immune to an effect or dodges an effect.
[*] Strike event will now only choose 2 employees randomly instead of 3 when players have more than 10 monsters in their active team.
[*] Damage amplification and reduction formula has been improved to avoid weird results to happen.
[*] New dungeons tooltip in the Schedule scene.
[*] Refresh price in the Shop has been reduced.
[*] Training and upgrading costs has been increased at the Trainer and Engineer.
[*] Vampire collectors prices, gold reward and life lost have been tweaked.
[*] The employees and traps panel can now be opened during tasks to check things around (nothing can be moved or swapped though).
[*] Added colors in effects tooltip description.
[*] Added effects description in Artefacts tooltips.
[*] Infernal Guardian visual has been updated.
[*] Yetigo visual has been updated.
[*] Terrified icon has been updated.
[*] Employees that were not in the active team before becoming locked are no longer put back in the active team when being available again if the active team is not full.
[*] Save slots are now beautiful and ergonomic.
[*] Save slots can now be named before being created.
[*] Players can now navigate between save slots, master selection and talent tree panel before starting a run.
[*] Players will now get experience on their master after ending or losing a run. Leveling up grants 1 talent point.
[*] Moral dealt by Demoralised is now scaling with the number of stacks. Base moral damage has been reduced accordingly.

notes.title: 6. Update Blood & Tears
notes.content:
You shared with us two things that we could improve in Legend of Keepers:
-Everything is related to gold
-There’s no difference between killing and scaring a hero

Thanks to your feedback, we are pleased to introduce our new game mechanics. Now when you kill a hero, you get blood from him. And if you make him run away, you get his tears. 

[previewyoutube=EO_WO8dwysM;full][/previewyoutube]

You will be able to use these two new resources in events, but also in some tasks. Here are the new tasks.

-Seminar: instead of paying for enraged effect, we will offer 3 possible seminars like in commercial department. You’ll pay with blood, tears and gold and get more varied bonuses.

-Fitness: in this event your dungeon master will be able to train, in exchange of blood and tears. This training will give him great improvements.

-Sanctuary: opposite of seminary, this place will allow you to make sacrifices with blood and tears to inflict heroes a penalty for the rest of the year.

We are still testing this new feature, that’s why your feedback is so important! Enjoy playing :)

Goblinz team

notes.title: 5. New recruits from the depths of hell!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33904811/4623075949b8f8991ae01cea603322c241b79b4c.png[/img]

You have been proving yourself and have become famous in the region. New monsters are now willing to work under your orders in the Dungeons Company!

Here’s a quick overview of these 3 demonic creatures!

Let’s start with the first one! Made of living stone, this flying [b]Gargoyle[/b] will scare heroes to death!

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/FFyjFLvY/gif1.gif[/img]


Here’s the turn of the [b]Flame Eater[/b]! This vicious fire entity will burn down adventurers into ashes in no time!

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/cJ7st0LB/gif2.gif[/img]


And the best one for the end: the [b]Infernal Guardian[/b]! When this greater demon will work for you, the squishiest humans won’t be able to hide behind their tanky friends anymore!

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/wBYqB7gB/gif3.gif[/img]


[h1]New norms to adapt to…[/h1]

The dungeon industry is constantly evolving. The high council of dungeoning is always revising or adding laws for dungeon companies.

We’re no exception and we have to respect them.

Too many heroes have been defeated easily lately (you must be the main responsible for this). It resulted in a decrease of adventurers interested in plundering, and actions had to be taken.

You will now have to choose between half of your active employees team and pool of traps when placing your forces.

We hope you’ll still show us that your the best one for the job!


-------------------------------------------------------------------

[h1]Patch notes for update 0.5.2.1:[/h1]

[u][b]Features, improvements and balancing:[/b][/u]

[list]
[*] Gargoyle, Flame Eater and Infernal Guardian are now available in game!
[*] Draft system overhaul: number of monsters and traps picked randomly for a room during preparation phase is based on the active employees team and traps.
[*] Lots of balancing for heroes.
[*] Lots of balancing for monsters.
[*] Slaveholder is now bulkier.
[*] Changed Slaveholder's Hold the line! spell to Show No Mercy! (applies Enraged to the next group of monster instead).
[*] Masters have now a Regeneration stat healing them for a few Life points each week.
[*] Balancing for artefacts effects.
[*] Artefacts max level is now 3 (reduced from 5).
[*] Added some new artefacts.
[*] Artefacts level is now displayed with gems in the UI in addition to being displayed in their tooltip.
[*] Effect stacks are now lost at the end of a fighter turns instead of at the start (damage over time are still dealt at the beginning of the turn).
[*] Skeleton Lord's passive revamped: Applies 3 stacks of Enraged to all Skeletons at the start of a dungeon.
[*] Added a progressive animation on life and morale bars.
[*] Several monsters can now be upgraded once with the Trainer.
[*] Several traps can now be upgraded once with the Engineer.
[*] Several monsters/traps can now be bought in the Shop.
[*] Added a new button in the Shop to refresh the elements available by paying some gold.
[*] The end of run/game over screen is now displaying the dungeon master's score.
[*] Monsters and traps obtained by transmuting an artefact with the Alchemist are now given with a level calculated from the level of the artefact transmuted.
[*] Adjustments made to several Events.
[*] Demoralised has been renamed into Terrified and Depressed has been renamed into Demoralised to avoid confusion between the two effects.
[*] Gold is now displayed on the reward screen.
[*] New team management button with a tooltip on the Schedule scene.
[*] Added sound on buttons still missing one.
[/list]

[u][b]Bugs fixing:[/b][/u]

[list]
[*] Fixed score displayed incorrectly on the end of run/game over screen.
[*] Fixed effect description not displayed correctly on a few traps, attacks and spells.
[*] Fixed an issue with the language chosen in the settings.
[*] Fixed several UI issues tied to screen resolution.
[*] Lots of other minor bugs fixed that would be too long to write down.
[/list]
